Added:
- A max turret level cap, currently set to level 3.
- Upgrade button becomes non-interactable and displays "MAX" once the cap is reached.

Improved Wave Spawn Countdown Logic

- Countdown now starts only when no enemies are alive
- Timer remains at 00:00 (seconds:milliseconds) during wave progression
- Prevented countdown from restarting until wave is cleared
- Ensured accurate UI display of seconds and milliseconds in format 00:00
- Added internal flags to manage countdown and wave states more cleanly

feature/upgadeShop

Added:
- Add modular turret upgrade system with utility and extension support
- Introduced `TurretUpgradeUtils`, a centralized utility class to handle turret attribute upgrades in a clean and reusable way.
- Created `TurretAttributes` struct to encapsulate upgradable turret values, enabling easier maintenance and logic separation.
- Added `UpgradeTurretAttributes` extension method on `TurretScriptable` for clean integration of the upgrade logic.
- Ensured floating-point values are rounded to two decimals to avoid floating point imprecision during upgrades.
- Connected utility system to `TurretUpgradeManager`, making the upgrade logic consistent across all turrets.

feature/selling

Added:
- Turret selling feature with dynamic sell price calculation
- Calculated sell price as half of total spent on turret (build + upgrades).
- Added Sell button functionality to refund player and remove turret.
- Updated UI to show current sell price dynamically.
- Improved code comments explaining the sell price formula.

feature/upgradeShop

Added:
- Turret Upgrade System with Dynamic UI and Cost Scaling
- Created a new UpgradeManager to handle turret upgrades, starting with Level as the first testable attribute.
- Cloning method added to TurretScriptable to prevent global ScriptableObject modification and to isolate turret instance data per node.
- Fixed "(Clone)" suffix by overriding the name in the Clone() method.
- Integrated UpgradeShopUI to dynamically show upgrade cost using the formula: baseCost * 0.5f * currentLevel.
- Upgrade Button text now displays cost in format: Upgrade "50", Upgrade "75", etc.
- Used PlayerStatsExtension.SpendMoney().
- SetTarget method in UpgradeShopUI now refreshes turret stats and cost after each upgrade.

feature/upgradeShop

Added:
- Hide UpgradeShopUI feature when clicking right click to deselect the selected turret
- TurretSelected Icon for aesthetic purposes on the UpgradeShop

Changes:
- ShopTurretHover.cs changed into ShopTurretSelected.cs to properly named its role in which it will show the Turret Info on the selected turret on the shop, mainly the TurretName and TurretCost, and it will hide the TurretInfo upon right click also.

feature/upgradeShop

Added:
- Add turret selection system with upgrade UI integration
- Implemented turret selection via BuildManager.SelectNode(Node node)
- Integrated UpgradeShopUI to display turret info when a node is selected
- Upgrade UI dynamically updates using data from TurretScriptableObject
- Added visual feedback using range visualizers for selected/deselected turrets

feature/pauseGame

Added:
- Added Restart Level functionality via GameManager.RestartGame()
- Combined Main Menu and Restart logic into a unified SceneTransitionHandler script
- Integrated Loading Screen on both Restart and Main Menu transitions

Updated UIManager to:
- Separate HidePauseScreen() and HideGameOverUI()
- Cleanly handle UI states during pause/resume and game over

Enabled Pause/Resume toggle with P key (For Testing purposes to be change into ESC on final)
- Ensured Time.timeScale resets on transitions

feature/gameOver

Added:
- Add simple loading screen transition when returning to main menu
- Created a ReturnToMainMenu script to handle scene transition with loading screen.
- Added support for a basic LoadingScreen UI panel that displays "Loading..." text.
- Time scale is reset before transitioning to ensure clean scene load.
- Connected button in Game Over screen to trigger the coroutine-based transition.

feature/gameOver

Added:
-Add live wave number display to HUD
-Added UpdateWaveNumberUI(int wave) method to UIManager to handle wave number display.
-Updated EnemySpawn to call this method whenever a new wave starts.
-Synced PlayerStats.Rounds with waveIndex to ensure accurate wave count on Game Over screen.
-Ensures players can see the current wave number in real time during gameplay.

feature/gameOver

Added:
-Game Over Screen Functionality
-Added EndGame() logic in GameManager to trigger GameOverState when player lives reach 0.
-Integrated GameOverState into the state machine with transitions from Playing to GameOver.
-Moved UI logic for displaying the Game Over screen into GameOverState.OnEnter().
-Paused game time using Time.timeScale = 0f when entering GameOverState to stop all gameplay.
-Ensured player input and enemy behavior respect the current game state to prevent interaction during Game Over.

feature/lives

Changes;
Refactored the PlayerStats.UpdatePlayerLives() method for better readability and clarity.

- Removed the use of negative values when updating lives.
- Now, the method expects a positive integer for damage or healing.
- This allows us to clearly use 'PlayerStats.Lives -= amount;' in the logic, which is more intuitive when reducing lives, instead of using '+= amount' with a negative value.

This change improves code readability and reduces confusion about whether lives are being added or subtracted.

Update README.md

Update README.md

feature/lives

Add configurable base damage per enemy type and starting lives setup

Added:
- Implemented dynamic base damage system: enemies now deal damage to the player base based on the 'DMGToBase' value set in their EnemyScriptable.
  - Example: A boss enemy can now deal 5 damage to the base instead of the default 1.
- Added support for setting the player's starting lives via the PlayerStats component.

feature/currency

Added:
Implemented Money System Integration for Turret Building and Enemy Kills

- Added PlayerStatsExtensions with SpendMoney(int) and AddMoney(int) methods to centralize money logic.
- Updated BuildManager to use SpendMoney when purchasing a turret.
- Now prevents turret placement if the player doesn't have enough money.
- Enemies now reward the player with money using AddMoney on death.
- Improved node hover feedback:
  - Nodes turn green if the player can afford a turret.
  - Nodes turn red if the player cannot afford it or it's already occupied.

feature/currency

Implemented UIManager & HUD integration for Money, Countdown, Wave, and Lives

Added:
Replaced direct UI updates in EnemySpawn with a centralized UIManager to handle all HUD elements.

UIManager now manages:
-Money display (auto-updated via PlayerStats.Money property setter)
-Wave countdown timer
-Wave number (placeholder, ready for expansion)
-Player lives (placeholder, ready for logic)

Created a basic HUD layout with TextMeshPro elements for:
-Money
-Countdown timer
-Wave number
-Lives

Ensured UIManager uses the Singleton pattern for easy access.
